item.title: Incarico post-doc: Development of organic, hybrid and bio-integrated materials and devices for sustainable electronics, photonics and hybrid living systems (HLS). (Univ. BOLZANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 12:00
Institution: Univ. BOLZANO, Bolzano
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-03 Fisica sperimentale della materia e applicazioni

The research focuses on the development of organic, hybrid and bio-integrated materials and devices for sustainable electronics, photonics and hybrid living systems (HLS). The research encompasses the design, fabrication and characterisation of organic/hybrid nanomaterials with tailored optoelectronic properties, such as (emissive) semiconductors and nanostructured systems compatible with sustainable fabrication processes. It also encompasses the fabrication, optimisation and integration of OLEDs, photodetectors, photovoltaic devices, sensors and optoelectronic platforms, including studies on charge transport, interfaces, multilayer architectures and device reliability. Further activities…

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Numerical models and data analysis for space weather investigations (Univ. della CALABRIA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 12:00
Institution: Univ. della CALABRIA, Rende
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-05 Astrofisica e cosmologia, fisica dello spazio, della terra e del clima

The research activities will be carried out within the framework of the "Space It Up" project and will be dedicated to the development and implementation of high-performance computing (HPC) codes and advanced parallelization techniques for the study of turbulence in space plasmas. The main objective will be the modelling of impulsive events that formed in the upper atmosphere of the Sun (corona) and that propagate in the interplanetary space reaching the Earth environment, by making use of magnetohydrodynamics codes, such as PLUTO and EUHFORIA

item.title: Incarico post-doc: Calibrating and monitoring the sub-detectors of the CALET experiment, which measures the flux of high-energy cosmic nuclei aboard the ISS (Univ. SIENA)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-29 23:59
Institution: Univ. SIENA, Siena
Field: Physics / 02/PHYS-01 Fisica sperimentale delle interazioni fondamentali e applicazioni

As part of the Italian participation, funded by the Italian Space Agency, related to the CALET mission, a calibration, monitoring and maintenance of simulations will be carried out for the sub-detectors of the CALET experiment. To ensure and improve the experiment's capability to measure the fluxes of high-energy cosmic nuclei aboard the ISS.
